Name: Skarecrohw's Hat Addons
Author: Skarecrohw
Description:
[u]Skarecrohw's Hat Addons![/u]

This mod adds 9 new hats to the game(5 models + variant colours)! Might not play nice with modded in hair-i dont use any so i wouldnt know-but as long as the hair is set up correctly things should run smoothly.
There is currently no way to get these hats in vanilla, so i suggest downloading CJB Item Spawner: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/[/url]


How To Install

[s]1. Please dont extract this directly into your stardew valley folders-go make a series of mod folders for organization if you dont already have that(it helps in the long run)[/s]
2. Extract my file to your general mods folder for easy access
3. Copy the 'Content' folder to your Stardew Valley folder. If you downloaded it via steam it should be here:
[disk]:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
4. Agree to overwrite files


How to Uninstall

(this is where having mod folders helps :P)

1. Head back into the extracted mod files
2. Copy the Content folder from 'Vanilla Backups' into your Stardew Valley folder and agree to overwrite
